property_summary: For every caller address, invoking owned() on the correct contract reverts for non-owners (only the owner can call it), so owner remains unchanged for all inputs; the mutant inverts the check allowing non-owners to successfully call owned(), so there exist caller addresses for which the call succeeds on the mutant but would fail on the reference.
change_summary: Invert onlyOwner check to require msg.sender != owner, making owner-only guarded functions callable by non-owners which could change owner through owned() if it modifies state.
